_comment: Damage reflection, design step 7 (docs/design/damage-reflection-pipeline.md 10): Loran's Escape. A
summoning-sick Boros Reckoner carries Guilty Conscience; four opponent Spirits make five creatures, so
Blasphemous Act costs {3}{R}: Plains + four Mountains pay the Escape's {W} and the Act. Without the
Escape the Act kills the Reckoner, its last-known reflection deals 13 (20 -> 7) and GC has no host left:
no win this turn and no creature afterwards. With the Escape cast on the Reckoner BEFORE the Act it
survives 13 (indestructible), reflects 13 to the face, GC deals 13 back, it reflects again: dead on
turn 4. The Act is FIRST in hand, so the line must not depend on hand order. The Escape's target is a
searched variant (the Reckoner, a Spirit, or nothing useful), the Reckoner's reflection target too.
